extension.description: Reviews commands with TypeSafe's Jev model under Assisted approval and Autopilot, stopping only clearly dangerous ones
settings.apiKey.title: API key
settings.apiKey.desc: TypeSafe API key. Stored encrypted; the extension never sees it, OpsKat adds it only to requests sent to the service URL below.
settings.baseUrl.title: Service URL
settings.baseUrl.desc: A service compatible with the TypeSafe System One API. The API key is sent only to this address.
settings.model.title: Model
settings.model.desc: Jev model name; defaults to jev-latest.
settings.threshold.title: Threshold
settings.threshold.desc: A number between 0 and 1. A command fails the review when the model's probability for any danger reaches it; lower is stricter.
